description: Zambia - Geo-located Health Facilities is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand", published or maintained by Zambia central statistics office (World Bank Group). The dataset contains the geo-location info, name and type of the health facilities in Zambia. The data is created by Zambia central statistical office, and curated from the Southern African Human-development Information Management Network (SAHIMS) static archive server To view metadata, please visit. Coverage: Zambia. It has 3 files in SHP ZIP, GeoJSON. The portal files it under Energy demand. The portal gives 2006 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
